record: V6 fixture 42 ball: authoritative simulation ball position / velocity per tick, the presentation ball (rendered) and the ownership flag; radius = the physical 0.11 m; contact = the simulation's swept keeper→ball resolution (tick 63, hand, weak parry through)
ownershipRule: the 3D renderer draws the ball (gk3dOwnsBall) when the SKELETAL_3D backend is active and the ball is held or within 3 m of the keeper; beyond that the 2D sprite ball draws (existing seam)
restHeight: simulation z 0 = a ball resting on the pitch; the rendered sphere centre is clamped to y = max(z, radius)
